premises.text: 5.4 billion people do not have smartphones and rely on SMS for communication
premises.evidence_span: not everyone in the world has a smartphone. Actually, there are 5.4 billion non-smartphones on the Earth right now.

premises.text: SMS is an inadequate communication method compared to smartphone applications
premises.evidence_span: we had to resort to SMS. We couldn't install all these cool smartphone applications on our phones.

premises.text: People in emerging economies spend a significant portion of their income on messaging
premises.evidence_span: people spend up to 5% of their monthly income on just messaging.

premises.text: The app allows users to send threaded messaging on non-smartphones
premises.evidence_span: users are able to send threaded iPhone-like threaded messaging on non-smartphones to their phone contacts.

premises.text: The app enables group messaging without incurring high SMS costs
premises.evidence_span: allow people to create groups with their phone contacts and send messages to them and don't have to pay for three times, five times, ten times the cost of SMS.

premises.text: The app provides location services to non-smartphones
premises.evidence_span: we bring location to non-smartphones, phones that don't have GPS.

premises.text: The app has a significant user base and demand in emerging markets
premises.evidence_span: Within two months, we had 400,000 downloads of a beta app.

premises.text: The app monetizes through advertisements that provide information to users
The platform aims to provide internet access and services to non-smartphone users
premises.evidence_span: I see SEIA as a platform that is going to bring internet access to people to have stuff like Yelp, iTunes, shopping on their non-smartphones.

value.text: Non-smartphone users gain access to enhanced messaging and internet services
value.evidence_span: we are giving billions of people in the world a mouthpiece to send messages and communicate.

notes: Fundraising and conference details excluded as traction.
